name: boardgame-kit
description:
Shared, engine-agnostic multiplayer plumbing (peer-to-peer session transport, seat/roster model, stable local identity, host-authoritative reducer helpers) extracted from parallel duplication across this workspace's digital boardgame ports (starcraft-tbg, meq). Consumed as raw TypeScript source (no build step) since every consumer already runs Vite/esbuild, which transpiles .ts from node_modules directly.

Design inspired by johnchampaign/digital-boardgame-framework (MIT, https://www.npmjs.com/package/digital-boardgame-framework) — specifically its small GameAdapter shape (applyAction/legalActions/currentActor/viewFor) and pluggable-store philosophy — but reimplemented from scratch for this workspace's fully peer-to-peer (PeerJS, no backend/Supabase) architecture rather than adopting that library directly.
